Prepare a DHS recode file and GPS dataset

Source: R/ingest.R
svy_from_dhs.Rd

Joins a DHS recode (e.g. KR, IR, HR, PR read with haven::read_dta()) to the DHS GPS dataset and standardises it with svy_standardize(). Weights are divided by 1,000,000 and interview dates are converted from century month code (CMC) with cmc_to_date().

Usage

svy_from_dhs(
  survey,
  gps,
  id_vars = c("v001", "v002", "v003"),
  cluster_var = "v001",
  weight_var = "v005",
  strata_var = "v022",
  cmc_var = "v008"
)

Arguments

survey

A DHS recode data frame.

gps

The DHS GPS dataset, as an sf object or data frame with columns DHSCLUST, LATNUM, LONGNUM and URBAN_RURA.

id_vars

Columns pasted together to form a unique record id. Use c("v001", "v002", "v003", "bidx") for the children's recode (KR) and c("hv001", "hv002", "hvidx") for the household member recode (PR).

cluster_var, weight_var, strata_var, cmc_var

Recode variable names for cluster, weight, stratum and interview CMC. Use the hv equivalents (hv001, hv005, hv022, hv008) for household-based recodes.

Value

An sf object in the standard schema. See svy_standardize().

Calendars

Ethiopia (Ethiopian calendar) and Nepal (Vikram Samvat) record CMC values in local calendars. Convert them to the Gregorian calendar before using interview dates for exposure matching. A warning is raised when the GPS country code is ET or NP.
